internal_diagnostics: QUERY STATUS (0x90) — single backward byte exposing 8 status bits: gear status, lamp failure, lamp on, limit error, fade running, reset state, missing short address, power failure.
QUERY LAMP FAILURE (0x92) — backward 0xFF on latched lamp failure.
QUERY LAMP POWER ON (0x93) — backward 0xFF when Actual Level > 0.
QUERY LIMIT ERROR (0x94) — backward 0xFF when last requested level was outside Min/Max window.
QUERY RESET STATE (0x95) — backward 0xFF in reset state.
QUERY MISSING SHORT ADDRESS (0x96) — backward 0xFF when Short Address = 0xFF.
QUERY ACTUAL LEVEL / MIN LEVEL / MAX LEVEL / POWER ON LEVEL / SYSTEM FAILURE LEVEL / FADE TIME-RATE (0xA0..0xA5).
READ MEMORY LOCATION (0xC5) — bank-0 GTIN / firmware version / identification / hardware version / implemented IEC 62386 parts.
Failure Status flash byte (Table 2 offset [29]) — latched across power cycles.
RANDOMIZE / COMPARE / WITHDRAW / SEARCH ADDRESS / VERIFY SHORT ADDRESS — addressing-iteration observability used during commissioning.
exception_response_observability: No NACK frame — DALI distinguishes success from failure only by presence/absence of the backward frame within the 7..22 TE window.
8-bit QUERY STATUS provides a single-snapshot view of all major fault conditions.
Latched Failure Status byte in flash survives power cycle.
Memory bank 0 (mandatory) exposes firmware version, hardware version, and GTIN — used for commissioning trace + asset management.
fields.scan_chain_topology: Not defined at protocol level — silicon-side scan chain insertion belongs to the implementing MCU / driver IP. The MSP430F2131 / MSP430G2xx2 used in SLAA422A provide a 4-wire JTAG and/or 2-wire Spy-Bi-Wire debug interface for in-system debug; these are MCU-vendor features, not DALI features.
fields.notes: DALI's observability is entirely protocol-level — every diagnostic surface (lamp failure / limit error / fade / reset / missing short address / power failure / version / device type / level value / memory bank / random address) is accessible via the QUERY command family + backward frame. Implementations that target DFT-clean silicon must add standard scan / MBIST / ATPG at the silicon level; the protocol does not constrain that.
